title: NetherIron Armour
description: This texturepack make iron armour appears to Netherite Armour
body:
# 🛡️Iron Armor→Netherite Armor

Ever wanted to look rich without doing any of the work? This texture pack transforms Iron Armor into the appearance of Netherite Armor, letting you show off the most intimidating armor set in Minecraft while secretly wearing ordinary iron gear.

Designed for fun, trolling, and friendly multiplayer pranks, this pack creates the illusion that you've conquered the Nether, mined Ancient Debris, and upgraded your gear to the strongest armor in the game. Meanwhile, your armor is still just Iron Armor behind the scenes.

## **✨ Features**
Replaces Iron Armor textures with Netherite Armor textures
Keeps all original Iron Armor stats and durability
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Works in survival and multiplayer worlds
Great for roleplay, trolling, and social experiments
Easy to install and use
![Before Texture pack and after Texture pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3ceb6acd0e51fd50a66a3635bc552bf11b4fded.png)**

## **🎭 Perfect For**
Convincing friends you're fully geared in Netherite
Showing up to PvP looking overpowered
Creating funny moments on servers
Harmless pranks and friendly deception

![No difference](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8733722e4084ef8f9715a92e01fff8827efcddce.png)

## **⚠️ Important**
This pack is visual only. It does not increase armor protection, durability, or provide any gameplay advantages. Iron Armor will still behave exactly like Iron Armor.

Whether you're fooling your friends, flexing fake wealth, or just looking for a fun cosmetic change, this pack is the perfect way to turn ordinary Iron Armor into a convincing Netherite disguise.

Look like a Netherite warrior. Fight like an Iron survivor. 😈🛡️
